summary: This note covers two details about blues harmonica player Charlie Musselwhite's recording career. In 1979 he recorded the album "The Harmonica According to Charlie Musselwhite" in London for Kicking Mule Records, meant to accompany an instructional book, and the album became popular enough to be released on CD. In June 2008 Blind Pig Records reissued it on 180-gram vinyl with new cover art.
one_line: Charlie Musselwhite's 1979 London harmonica album for Kicking Mule Records and its 2008 Blind Pig Records vinyl reissue.
